items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] What did Reuben Hughes play? Alto sax. He played alto. And this guy Saul Broad.

ctx.x: Oh, what did, go ahead. And he told me that he was going to, you know, take a two discs out of Baccarus' neck or something like that.
What did Reuben Hughes play? Alto sax. He played alto. And this guy Saul Broad.
Saul Broad was, as you know, the Jewish guy owned the nightclub where we played called Broad's Club Zombie.
